## Context / Problem
Fourteen call sites in `src/rebar/llm` hand-build the SAME single-turn structured request
shape: `mode="structured"` + `output_schema=<name>` + `execution_mode="single_turn"`, with
`system_prompt` / `instructions` / `config` / `reviewers`. Verified on the tree:
`overlap/judge.py:163,203`, `enrich.py:183`, `epic_bug_screen.py:266`,
`evals/eval_solver.py:167`, `plan_review/__init__.py:172`, `plan_review/prerequisites.py:231`,
`plan_review/xcheck.py:199,337`, `plan_review/completion_subcall.py:193`,
`plan_review/passes.py:469,582`, `workflow/completion_recovery.py:404`,
`code_review/workflow_ops.py:612`.

Two consequences of the copy-paste:

1. `RunRequest`'s own contract (`runner.py:96-100`) says a `single_turn` request must also carry
   `mode="structured"` + `output_schema` "so the two stay consistent" — but nothing enforces it;
   it is re-asserted by hand fourteen times.
2. The bounding decision is invisible. Only ONE of the fourteen declares any of the four
   lowering-only seams (`output_token_limit` / `structured_retry_limit` /
   `transport_attempt_limit` / `request_timeout_limit_s`): `judge_batch` (judge.py:211-214), and
   only `completion_recovery.py:413` sets a token cap. Confirmed by
   `grep -rn "output_token_limit=\|structured_retry_limit=\|transport_attempt_limit=\|request_timeout_limit_s=" src/rebar`.
   Omission is silent, so an unbounded site reads exactly like a deliberately-unbounded one.
   That is the shape of bug `leathery-druidic-nurseshark` (22da): it bounded `judge_batch` and
   the identical `judge_one` block four lines up stayed unbounded, unnoticed for days.

Not in scope, deliberately:
- **Bounding any site.** Every site keeps its CURRENT effective bounds. In particular
  `judge_one` stays unbounded: `kaolinite-head-wildebeest` (3939) closed `not_a_bug` on the
  grounds that `judge_one` has no production caller, and this story does not reopen it.
- **Model-class binding.** That is bug `afeb`'s mechanism (`cfg = replace(cfg, model=...)`)
  with its own oracle in `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py`; folding a `model_class`
  argument into the builder would CHANGE the model at the sites that deliberately inherit.
- **`build_usage_limits` / `iteration_limit_for`.** `build_usage_limits` returning the BARE
  `req_limit` is deliberate and documented (`structured_run.py:427-432`, RP-01 S2): telemetry
  and `completion_banking.iteration_limit_for`'s `2*B` inverse both read the bare base, and the
  retry allowance is an addend only inside the constructed `UsageLimits`. There is no drift to
  fix. A single-turn run makes one model call with `tools=[]`, so `iteration_limit` is a no-op
  for it and the builder does not expose it.

## Approach
One shared constructor for the shape; the bounds decision becomes a REQUIRED argument.

1. `structured_run.py` (leaf module): add a frozen dataclass `SingleTurnBounds` with four
   fields and **no defaults** — `output_tokens`, `timeout_s`, `structured_retries`,
   `transport_attempts`, each `int | None`. `None` means "inherit run-wide policy", which is
   what an omitted seam does today (every seam is lowering-only: `runner._effective_config`
   `min()`s timeout/transport, `structured_run.output_retry_allowance` `min()`s retries).
2. `runner.py`: add `RunRequest.for_structured(*, system_prompt, instructions, config,
   reviewers, output_schema, bounds, target=None)` — keyword-only, `bounds` required — which
   fixes `mode="structured"` and `execution_mode="single_turn"` and maps `bounds` onto the four
   `RunRequest` fields. Add `RunRequest.INHERIT_POLICY: ClassVar[SingleTurnBounds]`, the named
   all-`None` value, so a site that inherits says so in one greppable token and needs no new
   import.
3. Adopt at all fourteen sites. Thirteen pass `bounds=RunRequest.INHERIT_POLICY`; `judge_batch`
   passes its existing four values; `completion_recovery.py:404` passes its token cap with the
   other three `None`. Byte-identical resulting `RunRequest` at every site.
4. Extend the existing site oracle. `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py::_run_request_sites`
   matches only `node.func.id == "RunRequest"`, so after adoption it would stop seeing fourteen
   sites and FAIL OPEN. Teach it to accept `RunRequest.for_structured` as well. The frozen
   `_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES` table (24 entries, its keys, config expressions and verdicts)
   is UNCHANGED — the `config=` expression at each site is untouched — so this is an
   oracle-scope repair, not an assertion edit.

## Guard construction
Per the parent epic `airborne-wellloved-kingfisher`: owner module (`runner.py`) exempt; match
the AST conjunction that constitutes the construct — a direct `RunRequest(...)` call carrying
BOTH `execution_mode="single_turn"` and `mode="structured"` — never a single token; escape
marker `# single-turn-structured-ok: <reason>` with a mandatory non-empty reason, as
`scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py` uses; behaviour pinned only by the named existing tests.

## Scope
`src/rebar/llm/runner.py`, `src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py`, the fourteen call sites above,
`tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` (oracle scope only),
`tests/unit/test_run_request_builder.py` (new).

Line delta: adoption removes one line per site (two keywords out, one `bounds=` in); the shared
builder plus dataclass add roughly thirty. This child is about line-neutral, not net-negative;
the epic's net-negative criterion is a SUM over its consolidation children.

## Testing
- Builder unit tests: `for_structured` returns `mode="structured"` /
  `execution_mode="single_turn"`; each `SingleTurnBounds` field lands on its `RunRequest` field;
  `INHERIT_POLICY` leaves all four `None`.
- Edge: `for_structured(...)` without `bounds` raises `TypeError`; `SingleTurnBounds(...)`
  missing any field raises `TypeError`.
- Guard test (AST, `src/rebar` minus `runner.py`) with a marker-honouring escape and a test
  that an unreasoned marker does not excuse a site.
- Pinning, unchanged assertions: `tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py`,
  `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` (site table), `tests/unit/test_enrich.py`,
  `tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_banking.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No file under `src/rebar` except `runner.py` constructs a `RunRequest` carrying both
      `execution_mode="single_turn"` and `mode="structured"` without a reasoned
      `# single-turn-structured-ok:` marker; checked by the new guard test.
- [ ] Calling `RunRequest.for_structured` without `bounds`, and `SingleTurnBounds` with any
      field missing, both raise `TypeError`; checked by the builder edge tests.
- [ ] `_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES` still lists all 24 sites with the same keys, config
      expressions and verdicts after adoption; checked by
      `pytest tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py`.
- [ ] The pinning suites above pass with no assertion edits; checked by `pytest`.
